events.title: Attack UKMTO #160 9 October 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 13NM west of Al Jazeera, UAE. UKMTO has received reports from multiple sources that the vessel has been struck by an unknown projectile causing a fire which has since been extinguished. Status of the crew, damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at present. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

Attack UKMTO #158 7 October 2026 UKMTO WARNING 158-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 07 OCT 2026 Incident Time: 1900 UKMTO has received a report of an incident 51NM north of Madinat ash Shamal, Qatar. A tanker has reported being struck by multiple projectiles. Casualties have been reported. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

Attack UKMTO #159 6 October 2026 UKMTO has received a time-late report from a verified source, that a crude oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile on the 06 OCT2026, while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. There have been no reported casualties. Damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #156 5 October 2026 UKMTO_WARNING_156-26 Incident Date: 05 Oct 2026 Incident Time: 1637 UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident within the Strait of Hormuz. Suspicious Activity UKMTO #152 5 October 2026 UKMTO ADVISORY 152-26 SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 05 OCT 2026 Incident Time: 0827UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 11NM north of Khasab, Oman. A tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz inbound was hailed by the IRGC and instructed to turn back or the vessel would be targeted. The Master of the tanker has confirmed that they have complied with the instruction. Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
